static_profile.business_description: Alfa Laval AB — Swedish industrial group, global leader in heat transfer, separation (centrifuges), and fluid handling equipment, serving marine, energy, food/water, and process industries. Diversified end-market exposure vs. Atlas Copco's more compressor/tools-concentrated profile. Not sourced from a fetched figure - general public-record description, no numeric claims embedded.
static_profile.competitive_moat_notes: Strong engineering/switching-cost moat in heat-transfer and separation equipment; diversified across marine, energy, food & water end markets versus more concentrated industrial peers. Durable observation, not tied to a specific fetch date.

insider_activity_cache.notes: 10 transactions returned, searched as 'Alfa Laval', filtered to exact issuer match (Alfa Laval AB). ALL 10 are genuine open-market Acquisitions (none are option exercises), spanning 2023-11 to 2026-04, by 7 distinct insiders (board members Bresky, Bergink, Muller x2, Crauwels; CFO Ekstrom x2; other officers Moller, Kalra). Zero disposals in the visible window (FI page cap 15 rows). Most recent buy: Bresky, 553 shares at 542 SEK, 2026-04-24 (~4 months old, modest size). Positive multi-year pattern: consistent buying, no selling, spread across many people - the strongest insider signal of the three names, though not recent/large right now.

review_history.action: HOLD - best of the three on fundamentals+insider trend; valuation still rich (PEG 2.86), not an add at current price
